items.summaryEn: The winter admission of students to Kyrgyzstan's universities will begin on December 14. It will be held in four rounds and will last until January 23. You can apply for contracts that are vacant after the summer recruitment.

items.titleEn: Nvidia employees greeted Jensen Huang with applause after his return.
items.summaryEn: Nvidia co-founder and CEO Jensen Huang returned to the company's headquarters in Santa Clara, California, on November 23. Hundreds of employees greeted him with applause and chanted his name.
